google_help: Create a Google OAuth client with Application type 'Desktop app' and import the JSON downloaded from Google. Arbitrary JSON, Web application JSON, and non-Google API JSON are rejected. After validation, the OAuth client config and tokens are encrypted with Windows DPAPI under LocalAppData, so normal operation no longer depends on the original JSON file location.
oauth_imported_ok: The Google OAuth Desktop app JSON was validated and securely imported.
oauth_imported_token_reset: The OAuth Client ID changed, so the old Google token was removed. Connect Google again.
oauth_removed: The stored OAuth configuration and Google token were removed.
confirm_remove_oauth: Remove the stored OAuth configuration and Google token? You must import the Desktop app JSON again before reconnecting.
confirm_disconnect: Delete the Google auth token and disconnect? The imported OAuth config will remain so you can reconnect.
confirm_run: This will change Blogger posts using the saved, previewed rule. Original content will be backed up before writing. Continue?
dry_result: Dry Run: scanned {scanned}, {changed} posts would change.
google_disconnected: The Google auth token was removed. The imported OAuth config is retained.
supported_api_note: Supported API: v0.1 implements only Google Blogger API as a production connector. The Connection Test is Blogger-specific; this is not a generic 'run any API' feature. Future APIs are added as explicit connectors after implementation and policy review.
compliance_note: Compliance notes are an engineering review, not legal advice. Recheck official terms before commercial release or public distribution.
blogger_compliance: Blogger API: uses OAuth 2.0 Desktop app credentials, only the required scope, and the official API. User-supplied Desktop app JSON is strictly validated; Web application JSON and arbitrary JSON are rejected.
scheduler_compliance: Windows Task Scheduler: built-in Windows functionality. Tasks run LIMITED and interactive-user-only, with only the fixed application runner; arbitrary command execution is not exposed.
free_setup: Initial setup: designed without requiring a paid API subscription
desktop_note: Add links to Blogger posts. Preview before making changes.
select_credentials: Select Google OAuth Desktop app JSON
home_title: Add links to your Blogger posts in 3 steps
home_what: This app finds specified text in Google Blogger posts and inserts a link to a URL you choose. It does not generate entire articles or publish to other social networks.
home_example: Example: Find 'Product list' in a post and insert one link to your chosen URL. Check the number of affected posts in a dry run before making any edits.
home_connect_help: Import your Google Desktop app OAuth JSON, connect your account and test the Blogger connection.
home_job_help: Choose the blog, text to match and destination URL. Start with a small number of posts.
home_preview_help: Select a saved job and click 'Preview (no changes)' to review affected-post counts. Live execution is enabled after a successful preview.
home_schedule_help: You can add Windows scheduling later, when you need it.
home_state_config_missing: Status: OAuth client configuration is missing
home_state_auth_missing: Status: OAuth client imported; connect Google next
home_state_auth_present: Status: credentials saved (API connection must still be tested)
home_state_jobs_error: Status: saved rules could not be read; check the error
home_state_preview_done: Status: a preview ran during this session; preview again after editing
home_state_preview_needed: Status: no successful preview in this session; no posts changed
save_changes_first: These form values are not saved. Click 'Save Job' first and run the preview again before making changes.
preview_required_before_live: Run 'Preview (no changes)' first. Repeat the preview after changing or saving the job.
busy_processing: An operation is already in progress.
home_state_api_verified: Status: Blogger API connection verified in this session
oauth_saved_unverified: Credentials saved; API connection not yet verified
google_first_setup: First-time setup: follow these steps from left to right
google_first_setup_tip: 1) Import JSON → 2) Connect Google → 3) Test Connection. Then return to Start Here to create a rule.
job_effect_missing: Enter match text and a link URL to see the action summary. Save the rule and preview real posts before updating.
job_effect_template: Check up to {count} posts, find '{target}', and turn it into a link labeled '{anchor}' pointing to {url}. Posts with the same link, and other nonmatching posts, are skipped.
preview_required_before_schedule: Save and preview the selected job before scheduling it. The saved Blogger write settings must match the successful preview.
confirm_schedule_changes: This job will run automatically at the scheduled times and may change Blogger posts. Have you reviewed its scope and link destination in a preview? Register it?
confirm_discard_edits: You have unsaved changes. Discard them and open another rule?
schedule_advanced_notice: Registered jobs automatically edit Blogger posts while you are logged into Windows. Before enabling them, preview the rule and verify the target blog and link destination.
google_connection_failed: Blogger API connection check failed. Verify Google credentials and network access.
